title: So what does it do?

It starts a natural process that can never be undone. Like a crack in a crystalline dam. From this day on, as you go about your life — whether you realize it or not — that crack will grow. In time this great, invisible wall will be shot through with an unseen fracturing. You do not need to do anything, really, to grow this fracture. It’s inevitable because there is an immense power beyond this dam that did not even realize it was trapped. And the moment it notices that very first crack in the wall, it will swell against it and never cease. It will tear apart the wall because it wants to be free. Because it knows now.
